metadata.title: When you accidentally get a kill and instantly think you cracked Valorant’s code
metadata.description:
Thought I missed but nope, game just blessed me.
Who needs aim when RNG is on your side?
Click if your 1 kill feels like a full ace!

Click if you ever won by pure accident!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
